text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm out observing things at the training
track
when I notice Agnes Digital doing
the same.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how I love watching my Umas do
partner
runs! Look at them wordlessly
communicating with
their gazes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's because of you that I was able to
surpass my
own limits!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Come! Chase after me and catch me! I
know you
can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And who comes running after her but her
dearest
friend and rival! Oooh! What
unrestrained
passion!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! That was a splendid etude of
yours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! O-Opera O?! Wh-wh-what are you
doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Curse myself for failing to blend into the
wall!
And worse, I've been overheard
fangirling about
my oshis!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My word, your skill at improv theater is

phenomenal! Digital, would you be
interested in
taking the stage with me?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There, we will project our voices
together in
operatic song, spreading
word of my great deeds
as Overlord
throughout the world!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, Opera O's got another one
cornered...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
I heard she made a girl in the class next
to ours
perform her original opera for
eight hours
straight...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A moment, if you please. I also have
business with
Digital... as she is an
important subject of my
ongoing
observations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Tachyon too?! And... wow,
did you
just call me important?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I am currently studying the mechanism
by which
she transforms her passion for
Umamusume into
power.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Tachyon's joined in too!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
I heard she made a student in the class
next to
ours participate in some really
terrifying
experiment...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital, why do you hesitate? Come!
Take my
hand at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've already prepared the laboratory for
my
experiment, and I'd like to start
testing my
hypotheses as soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what should I do? Ohhh, this is
terrible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being forced to choose between the
lesser of two
evils, Agnes Digital
appears understandably
conflicted.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Who said I don't want to do what
they're
asking me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sharing a stage with Opera O and being
a test
subject for Tachyon are both
dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't know if I'm worthy of
such
important tasks!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Can I truly live up to my oshis'
expectations? No
matter how much
research I do, I'm scared to find
out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Both Opera O and Tachyon have such
firm,
unwavering grasps on their own
worlds...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I would say the same for Agnes Digital,
but she
doesn't seem very confident.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I can't... I'm no more than a mere
simp,
unworthy of coexisting on the
same plane as
them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! What's my problem?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Straight to jail for me! Turning down a
request
from one's oshi is an offense
beyond redemption!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Such considerations have no place
crossing a fan's
mind! The only course of
action here is to accept
all requests!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I knew I was right in choosing you! What
an open
mind you have!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, it would be an intriguing
study to
observe you both performing an
opera together...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Teehuehue... If my fangirly delusions can
help out
my oshis, then I must accept
this honor without
fear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Digital spends a great
many hours
both performing operas and
being under
observation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Could it be that the depth of my love for my oshis is being tested here, in this very moment?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Causing my oshis trouble just because I
can't
make up my mind is unacceptable!
Inexcusable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's a simp's job to have all her faves' schedules memorized!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, please let me stand under the
spotlight
with you! We should be able to
borrow the stage
this weekend!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a fine idea! We'll certainly need
one if we
are to entertain an audience!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Not only are you a skilled
playwright,
you even possess fantastic
managerial skills!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, since we share the same room,
do you
think you could conduct your
observations in
Ritto Dorm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you suggesting I observe you as you
observe
other Ritto residents? I see. A
very reasonable
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And perhaps it will be me whom you
decide to
observe... Heh. This is sure to
be intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I will devote every fiber of my being to
creating a
stupendous opera and
incredible study results!
